name: nimbo_list_servers
title: List servers
description: Lists the servers of the project with their status, size, region and IP addresses.

name: nimbo_get_server
title: Get a server
description: Shows one server: status, size, image, IP addresses, attached volumes and tags.

name: nimbo_create_server
title: Create a server
description: Creates a new server from an image, in a region and at a size.

name: nimbo_delete_server
title: Delete a server
description: Destroys a server and its local disk. Attached volumes are kept.

name: nimbo_start_server
title: Start a server
description: Powers on a server that is stopped.

name: nimbo_stop_server
title: Stop a server
description: Shuts a server down cleanly, as the shutdown command would. It keeps its IP and disk.

name: nimbo_power_off_server
title: Power off a server
description: Cuts the power of a server at once, without a clean shutdown, as pulling the plug.

name: nimbo_reboot_server
title: Reboot a server
description: Restarts a server cleanly.

name: nimbo_resize_server
title: Resize a server
description: Changes the size of a server: more or fewer CPUs, more or less memory.

name: nimbo_rename_server
title: Rename a server
description: Gives a server a new name.

name: nimbo_rebuild_server
title: Rebuild a server
description: Reinstalls a server from an image, erasing its disk and keeping its IP.

name: nimbo_get_server_console
title: Open the server console
description: Gives a link to the web console of a server, to log in when SSH does not answer.

name: nimbo_get_server_metrics
title: Get server metrics
description: Shows the CPU, memory, disk and bandwidth use of a server over a period.

name: nimbo_tag_server
title: Tag a server
description: Adds a tag to a server, to group it with others.

name: nimbo_untag_server
title: Untag a server
description: Removes a tag from a server.

name: nimbo_enable_server_ipv6
title: Enable IPv6 on a server
description: Gives a server an IPv6 address.

name: nimbo_reset_server_password
title: Reset the root password
description: Sets a new root password on a server and sends it by email.

name: nimbo_get_server_logs
title: Get server logs
description: Shows the last lines of the system log of a server.

name: nimbo_enable_rescue_mode
title: Boot in rescue mode
description: Restarts a server on a rescue system, to repair a disk or a broken boot.

name: nimbo_disable_rescue_mode
title: Leave rescue mode
description: Restarts a server on its own disk after rescue mode.

name: nimbo_list_sizes
title: List server sizes
description: Lists the server sizes: CPUs, memory, disk, transfer and monthly price.

name: nimbo_list_regions
title: List regions
description: Lists the data center regions and what each one offers.

name: nimbo_list_volumes
title: List volumes
description: Lists the block storage volumes, their size and the server each one is attached to.

name: nimbo_get_volume
title: Get a volume
description: Shows one volume: size, region, file system and attached server.

name: nimbo_create_volume
title: Create a volume
description: Creates a block storage volume, an extra disk for a server.

name: nimbo_delete_volume
title: Delete a volume
description: Destroys a volume and all its data. It must be detached first.

name: nimbo_attach_volume
title: Attach a volume
description: Attaches a volume to a server, where it shows up as a new disk.

name: nimbo_detach_volume
title: Detach a volume
description: Detaches a volume from its server. The data stays on the volume.

name: nimbo_resize_volume
title: Resize a volume
description: Makes a volume bigger. A volume can grow but never shrink.

name: nimbo_list_snapshots
title: List snapshots
description: Lists the snapshots of servers and volumes, with their size and date.

name: nimbo_create_server_snapshot
title: Snapshot a server
description: Takes a snapshot of a server disk at this moment, kept until deleted.

name: nimbo_create_volume_snapshot
title: Snapshot a volume
description: Takes a snapshot of a volume at this moment.

name: nimbo_delete_snapshot
title: Delete a snapshot
description: Deletes a snapshot for good.

name: nimbo_restore_snapshot
title: Restore a snapshot
description: Puts a server or a volume back to the state of a snapshot, erasing what came after.

name: nimbo_volume_from_snapshot
title: Create a volume from a snapshot
description: Creates a new volume holding the data of a volume snapshot, leaving the original alone.

name: nimbo_list_backups
title: List backups
description: Lists the automatic backups of a server, newest first.

name: nimbo_enable_backups
title: Turn on automatic backups
description: Turns on the automatic weekly backups of a server.

name: nimbo_disable_backups
title: Turn off automatic backups
description: Turns off the automatic backups of a server. Existing backups are deleted.

name: nimbo_get_backup_schedule
title: Get the backup schedule
description: Shows when the automatic backups of a server run and how long they are kept.

name: nimbo_set_backup_schedule
title: Set the backup schedule
description: Changes the day, the hour and the retention of the automatic backups of a server.

schedule.description: When to run, as a cron expression

name: nimbo_restore_backup
title: Restore a backup
description: Puts a server back to the state of one of its automatic backups.

name: nimbo_backup_now
title: Run a backup now
description: Starts an extra backup of a server right away, outside the schedule.

name: nimbo_list_images
title: List images
description: Lists the images a server can be created from: distributions, apps and your own images.

name: nimbo_get_image
title: Get an image
description: Shows one image: system, version, minimum disk size and regions.

name: nimbo_create_image
title: Create a custom image
description: Saves a server as a custom image, to create more servers like it.

name: nimbo_import_image
title: Import an image
description: Imports a disk image from a URL as a custom image.

name: nimbo_delete_image
title: Delete a custom image
description: Deletes one of your custom images.

name: nimbo_copy_image
title: Copy an image to a region
description: Copies a custom image to another region so servers can be created there.

name: nimbo_list_ssh_keys
title: List SSH keys
description: Lists the SSH public keys of the account, with their fingerprint.

name: nimbo_add_ssh_key
title: Add an SSH key
description: Adds an SSH public key to the account, to install on new servers.

name: nimbo_delete_ssh_key
title: Delete an SSH key
description: Removes an SSH public key from the account. Servers already built keep it.

name: nimbo_list_firewalls
title: List firewalls
description: Lists the cloud firewalls and how many servers each protects.

name: nimbo_get_firewall
title: Get a firewall
description: Shows one firewall: its inbound and outbound rules and its servers.

name: nimbo_create_firewall
title: Create a firewall
description: Creates a cloud firewall with a first set of rules.

rule.description: Rule: protocol, port range and sources

name: nimbo_delete_firewall
title: Delete a firewall
description: Deletes a firewall. Its servers are left open to all traffic.

name: nimbo_add_firewall_rule
title: Add a firewall rule
description: Adds an inbound or outbound rule to a firewall, to allow a port from some sources.

rule.description: Rule: protocol, port range and sources

name: nimbo_remove_firewall_rule
title: Remove a firewall rule
description: Removes a rule from a firewall, closing that port.

rule.description: Rule: protocol, port range and sources

name: nimbo_apply_firewall
title: Apply a firewall to a server
description: Puts a server behind a firewall.

name: nimbo_remove_firewall_server
title: Take a server out of a firewall
description: Takes a server out of a firewall, without deleting the firewall.

name: nimbo_list_load_balancers
title: List load balancers
description: Lists the load balancers with their IP and state.

name: nimbo_get_load_balancer
title: Get a load balancer
description: Shows one load balancer: rules, targets, health of each target.

name: nimbo_create_load_balancer
title: Create a load balancer
description: Creates a load balancer that spreads traffic over servers.

name: nimbo_delete_load_balancer
title: Delete a load balancer
description: Deletes a load balancer. Its servers are kept.

name: nimbo_add_lb_target
title: Add a server to a load balancer
description: Adds a server to the targets a load balancer sends traffic to.

name: nimbo_remove_lb_target
title: Remove a server from a load balancer
description: Stops sending traffic to a server, without touching the server.

name: nimbo_set_lb_health_check
title: Set the health check
description: Changes how a load balancer checks that its servers answer: path, port and interval.

name: nimbo_add_lb_forwarding_rule
title: Add a forwarding rule
description: Forwards a port of the load balancer to a port of its servers, with its protocol.

rule.description: Rule: protocol, port range and sources

name: nimbo_set_lb_sticky_sessions
title: Set sticky sessions
description: Keeps each visitor on the same server with a cookie, or turns that off.

name: nimbo_list_networks
title: List private networks
description: Lists the private networks (VPC) and their IP ranges.

name: nimbo_create_network
title: Create a private network
description: Creates a private network so servers talk to each other without the internet.

name: nimbo_delete_network
title: Delete a private network
description: Deletes an empty private network.

name: nimbo_add_network_server
title: Connect a server to a private network
description: Gives a server an address on a private network.

name: nimbo_remove_network_server
title: Disconnect a server from a private network
description: Removes a server from a private network.

name: nimbo_list_floating_ips
title: List floating IPs
description: Lists the floating IP addresses and the server each one points to.

name: nimbo_reserve_floating_ip
title: Reserve a floating IP
description: Reserves a new floating IP address in a region.

name: nimbo_release_floating_ip
title: Release a floating IP
description: Gives a floating IP address back. It cannot be recovered.

name: nimbo_assign_floating_ip
title: Assign a floating IP
description: Points a floating IP address at a server, moving it from its current server if needed.

name: nimbo_unassign_floating_ip
title: Unassign a floating IP
description: Detaches a floating IP from its server and keeps it reserved.

name: nimbo_set_reverse_dns
title: Set reverse DNS
description: Sets the reverse DNS name (PTR) of an IP address, which mail servers check.

name: nimbo_list_domains
title: List domains
description: Lists the domains whose DNS is hosted here.

name: nimbo_add_domain
title: Add a domain
description: Adds a domain to the DNS service. Its name servers must then point here.

name: nimbo_delete_domain
title: Delete a domain
description: Removes a domain and all its DNS records.

name: nimbo_list_dns_records
title: List DNS records
description: Lists the DNS records of a domain: A, CNAME, MX, TXT and others.

type.description: Record type: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV or CAA

name: nimbo_create_dns_record
title: Create a DNS record
description: Adds a DNS record to a domain, such as a subdomain pointing at a server.

type.description: Record type: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV or CAA

name: nimbo_update_dns_record
title: Update a DNS record
description: Changes the value or the TTL of a DNS record.

name: nimbo_delete_dns_record
title: Delete a DNS record
description: Removes one DNS record from a domain.

name: nimbo_check_dns_propagation
title: Check DNS propagation
description: Asks public resolvers around the world what they answer for a name.

name: nimbo_list_certificates
title: List certificates
description: Lists the TLS certificates with their domains and expiry date.

name: nimbo_get_certificate
title: Get a certificate
description: Shows one TLS certificate: domains, issuer, expiry and where it is used.

name: nimbo_request_certificate
title: Request a free certificate
description: Requests a free Let's Encrypt certificate for some domains, renewed on its own.

name: nimbo_upload_certificate
title: Upload a certificate
description: Uploads a certificate bought elsewhere, with its private key and chain.

name: nimbo_renew_certificate
title: Renew a certificate
description: Renews a certificate now, before it expires.

name: nimbo_delete_certificate
title: Delete a certificate
description: Deletes a certificate that nothing uses any more.

name: nimbo_list_databases
title: List database clusters
description: Lists the managed database clusters: engine, version, size and state.

name: nimbo_get_database
title: Get a database cluster
description: Shows one database cluster: engine, nodes, storage use and maintenance window.

name: nimbo_create_database
title: Create a database cluster
description: Creates a managed PostgreSQL, MySQL or Redis cluster.

name: nimbo_delete_database
title: Delete a database cluster
description: Destroys a database cluster and all its data.

name: nimbo_resize_database
title: Resize a database cluster
description: Moves a database cluster to a bigger or smaller size, or changes its number of nodes.

name: nimbo_get_database_connection
title: Get connection details
description: Gives the host, port, user and connection string to reach a database cluster.

name: nimbo_list_database_users
title: List database users
description: Lists the users of a database cluster.

name: nimbo_create_database_user
title: Create a database user
description: Adds a user to a database cluster with a generated password.

name: nimbo_delete_database_user
title: Delete a database user
description: Removes a user from a database cluster.

name: nimbo_reset_database_password
title: Reset a database user password
description: Gives a database user a new generated password.

name: nimbo_list_database_backups
title: List database backups
description: Lists the daily backups of a database cluster.

name: nimbo_restore_database
title: Restore a database to a point in time
description: Creates a new database cluster from a backup or from any minute of the last seven days.

name: nimbo_add_read_replica
title: Add a read replica
description: Adds a read-only copy of a database cluster, in the same or another region.

name: nimbo_remove_read_replica
title: Remove a read replica
description: Removes a read-only copy of a database cluster.

name: nimbo_set_database_trusted_sources
title: Set trusted sources
description: Limits which servers and IP addresses may connect to a database cluster.

rule.description: Rule: protocol, port range and sources

name: nimbo_upgrade_database
title: Upgrade the database engine
description: Moves a database cluster to a newer major version of its engine.

name: nimbo_set_maintenance_window
title: Set the maintenance window
description: Chooses the day and hour when a database cluster may be updated.

schedule.description: When to run, as a cron expression

name: nimbo_list_slow_queries
title: List slow queries
description: Lists the slowest queries a database cluster ran recently.

name: nimbo_list_buckets
title: List buckets
description: Lists the object storage buckets and their size.

name: nimbo_create_bucket
title: Create a bucket
description: Creates an object storage bucket to keep files.

name: nimbo_delete_bucket
title: Delete a bucket
description: Deletes an empty bucket.

name: nimbo_list_objects
title: List objects in a bucket
description: Lists the files in a bucket, under a prefix.

key.description: Key of the object in the bucket

name: nimbo_upload_object
title: Upload a file to a bucket
description: Uploads a file to a bucket under a key.

key.description: Key of the object in the bucket

name: nimbo_delete_object
title: Delete a file from a bucket
description: Deletes one file from a bucket.

key.description: Key of the object in the bucket

name: nimbo_get_object_link
title: Get a temporary link
description: Gives a signed link to download a private file from a bucket, valid for some minutes.

key.description: Key of the object in the bucket

name: nimbo_set_bucket_access
title: Set bucket access
description: Makes a bucket private or lets anyone read its files.

name: nimbo_set_bucket_cors
title: Set CORS rules
description: Sets which websites may load files from a bucket in a browser.

rule.description: Rule: protocol, port range and sources

name: nimbo_set_bucket_lifecycle
title: Set a lifecycle rule
description: Deletes files on their own after some days, or the old versions of files.

rule.description: Rule: protocol, port range and sources

name: nimbo_create_access_key
title: Create storage access keys
description: Creates an access key and secret for the object storage API.

name: nimbo_enable_cdn
title: Turn on the CDN
description: Serves the files of a bucket through the CDN, cached near visitors.

name: nimbo_purge_cdn_cache
title: Purge the CDN cache
description: Removes files from the CDN cache so visitors get the new versions.

key.description: Key of the object in the bucket

name: nimbo_list_clusters
title: List Kubernetes clusters
description: Lists the Kubernetes clusters, their version and node count.

name: nimbo_get_cluster
title: Get a Kubernetes cluster
description: Shows one Kubernetes cluster: version, node pools and state.

name: nimbo_create_cluster
title: Create a Kubernetes cluster
description: Creates a managed Kubernetes cluster with a first node pool.

name: nimbo_delete_cluster
title: Delete a Kubernetes cluster
description: Destroys a Kubernetes cluster and its nodes.

name: nimbo_upgrade_cluster
title: Upgrade a Kubernetes cluster
description: Moves a Kubernetes cluster to a newer version.

name: nimbo_get_kubeconfig
title: Get the kubeconfig
description: Gives the kubeconfig file to reach a cluster with kubectl.

name: nimbo_list_node_pools
title: List node pools
description: Lists the node pools of a Kubernetes cluster and their sizes.

name: nimbo_add_node_pool
title: Add a node pool
description: Adds a group of worker nodes of one size to a Kubernetes cluster.

name: nimbo_scale_node_pool
title: Scale a node pool
description: Changes the number of nodes in a node pool, or its autoscaling limits.

name: nimbo_delete_node_pool
title: Delete a node pool
description: Removes a node pool and its nodes from a cluster.

name: nimbo_recycle_node
title: Replace a node
description: Drains one node of a cluster and replaces it with a fresh one.

name: nimbo_list_apps
title: List apps
description: Lists the apps deployed from a Git repository, with their live URL.

name: nimbo_get_app
title: Get an app
description: Shows one app: its components, its live URL and its last deployment.

name: nimbo_create_app
title: Create an app
description: Creates an app that builds and deploys a Git repository on each push.

name: nimbo_delete_app
title: Delete an app
description: Deletes an app and takes it offline.

name: nimbo_deploy_app
title: Deploy an app
description: Builds and deploys the latest commit of an app now.

name: nimbo_list_deployments
title: List deployments
description: Lists the deployments of an app, with their state and commit.

name: nimbo_rollback_app
title: Roll back an app
description: Goes back to an earlier deployment of an app.

name: nimbo_get_build_logs
title: Get build logs
description: Shows the build output of a deployment, to see why it failed.

name: nimbo_get_app_logs
title: Get app logs
description: Shows what a running app writes to its output.

name: nimbo_set_app_env
title: Set environment variables
description: Sets the environment variables of an app; it redeploys.

variables.description: Variables as a map of names to values

name: nimbo_add_app_domain
title: Add a domain to an app
description: Serves an app on your own domain, with a certificate.

name: nimbo_list_alert_policies
title: List alert policies
description: Lists the alert policies: what they watch, their threshold and who they warn.

name: nimbo_create_alert_policy
title: Create an alert policy
description: Warns by email or Slack when a metric of a server crosses a threshold.

rule.description: Rule: protocol, port range and sources

name: nimbo_delete_alert_policy
title: Delete an alert policy
description: Deletes an alert policy.

name: nimbo_list_alerts
title: List alerts
description: Lists the alerts that fired, open ones first.

name: nimbo_acknowledge_alert
title: Acknowledge an alert
description: Marks an alert as seen, so it stops warning people.

name: nimbo_mute_alert_policy
title: Mute an alert policy
description: Silences an alert policy for some minutes, during planned work.

name: nimbo_create_uptime_check
title: Create an uptime check
description: Checks a URL from several regions every minute and warns when it does not answer.

name: nimbo_get_uptime
title: Get uptime
description: Shows the uptime and response times of an uptime check over a period.

name: nimbo_list_projects
title: List projects
description: Lists the projects that group resources.

name: nimbo_create_project
title: Create a project
description: Creates a project to group resources.

name: nimbo_delete_project
title: Delete a project
description: Deletes an empty project.

name: nimbo_move_to_project
title: Move resources to a project
description: Moves servers, volumes or databases to another project.

name: nimbo_list_team_members
title: List team members
description: Lists the people of the team and their role.

name: nimbo_invite_team_member
title: Invite a team member
description: Sends an invitation by email to join the team with a role.

role.description: Role: owner, member, billing or read-only

name: nimbo_remove_team_member
title: Remove a team member
description: Removes a person from the team; their access ends at once.

name: nimbo_change_member_role
title: Change a member role
description: Gives a team member another role.

role.description: Role: owner, member, billing or read-only

name: nimbo_list_api_tokens
title: List API tokens
description: Lists the personal API tokens, their scopes and last use.

name: nimbo_create_api_token
title: Create an API token
description: Creates a personal API token for scripts, with read or write scope.

name: nimbo_revoke_api_token
title: Revoke an API token
description: Revokes an API token at once.

name: nimbo_list_audit_events
title: List the audit log
description: Lists who did what on the account and when: creations, deletions, logins.

name: nimbo_get_balance
title: Get the current balance
description: Shows what the month costs so far and the amount due.

name: nimbo_get_usage
title: Get usage by resource
description: Breaks down the cost of the month by project and by resource.

name: nimbo_list_invoices
title: List invoices
description: Lists the monthly invoices and whether each one is paid.

name: nimbo_get_invoice_pdf
title: Download an invoice
description: Gives the PDF of one invoice.

name: nimbo_set_spending_alert
title: Set a spending alert
description: Sends an email when the month costs more than an amount.

name: nimbo_list_support_tickets
title: List support tickets
description: Lists the support tickets of the account and their status.

name: nimbo_open_support_ticket
title: Open a support ticket
description: Asks the support team for help with a message.

name: nimbo_reply_support_ticket
title: Reply to a support ticket
description: Adds a message to an open support ticket.

name: nimbo_close_support_ticket
title: Close a support ticket
description: Closes a support ticket that is solved.

name: nimbo_get_status_page
title: Get the platform status
description: Shows the incidents and planned maintenance of the platform, by region.
